newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-LEADING SCORES AFTER FINAL ROUND OF BUICK CHALLENGE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-LEADING SCORES AFTER FINAL ROUND OF BUICK CHALLENGE.

text.p: Michael Bradley
won the $1 million Buick Challenge on Sunday with a birdie on
the first extra hole after the tournament was shortened to 36
holes because of rain.
Leading scores after the final round on the 7,057-yard,
par-72 Callaway Gardens course (players U.S. unless stated):
